name: Coll del Moro – Franco's observation post, Gandesa
story: From this 470 m hill west of Gandesa, on top of an Iberian settlement and necropolis, the Nationalist command watched the Battle of the Ebro. Franco himself came here, as did senior commanders and foreign military observers. The Nationalists' approach relied on artillery and air superiority to wear down the Republican bridgehead in a series of costly counter-offensives rather than seeking manoeuvre. From the observation post the whole southern battlefield is visible, from Gandesa to the Pàndols and Cavalls ridges.
see: The Nationalist observation post and its surroundings alongside the excavated Iberian tower and settlement; wide views over the Terra Alta battlefield.
plan: Beside the N-420 at km 795.5; the Iberian site is visited by reservation only (reservesmonuments.acdpc@gencat.cat, tel. 977 638 556).
